summary: Index cross-sprint status reads for autonomous queue snapshots

delivery.outcome: Status-filtered cross-sprint queue reads use an ordered SQLite index, including databases created before this change, without altering ticket data or admission decisions.

architecture.decision: Ensure one additive status-position index when opening the disposable ticket projection. Already upgraded databases keep the read path; no source-data rewrite or ticket-state change. Regression evidence checks query plans, bounded SQLite work, unchanged payload order and concurrent migration.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded source change through independent publication. The additive index remains harmless and ticket sources are unchanged.

nonGoals: No queue gate bypass, status change, execution grant, unbounded concurrency increase or runtime rewrite.

validation.evidence: Fresh and existing databases use indexed ordered status reads and retain exact ticket payloads.
Connections close correctly, concurrent migration is idempotent and existing ticket index behavior is preserved.
